title: ThreeBrowser Studio MCP tool inputs
description: Protocol three-studio/1. Every declared object rejects unknown properties. Domain payloads are JSON and receive a second strict validation in the authoring kernel.

cameraFrameTarget.description: Exact committed entity bounds or explicit document-space bounds for a persistent authored shot.

rtxPatch.description: A partial canonical native ray-query lighting configuration. At least one field is required.

layoutPattern.description: A canonical live-instancing layout pattern. Grid count products and all pattern counts must not exceed 8192. Scatter is deterministic for a given signed 32-bit seed.

geometryEditCommand.description: One strict indexed-triangle or editable-polygon mesh edit. Rotations use radians and either XYZ rotation or axis plus angle.

blenderModifierOperatorType.description: One exact Blender 5.2 Object Modifier Type Items identifier for an explicit bake boundary.

modifierDisplacementSource.description: Deterministic inline scalar source; texture and vertex-group references are not live.

modifierDocument.description: Strict canonical modifier document. Objects reject unknown controls; types not listed here require bakeBoundary.

oneOf.description: Pattern modifiers are further discriminated by mode; grid products and every final instance count are bounded to 8192.
Live decimation by either ratio or target triangle count; the two controls are mutually exclusive.

modifierPatch.description: A strict type-specific partial modifier control set. Inspect modifierDigest first; id and type are immutable. Null removes an optional authored setting.

anyOf.description: Strict partial controls for triangulate or common visibility flags on any modifier; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for array; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for mirror; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for pattern; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for weld; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for smooth; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for weightedNormal; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for edgeSplit; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for solidify; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for subdivision; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for decimate; ratio and targetTriangles cannot both be non-null.
Strict partial controls for displace; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.
Strict partial controls for bakeBoundary; inspect modifierDigest before patching because id and type are immutable.

modifierStackChange.description: One ordered edit in a hash-guarded modifier stack batch. Modifier payloads receive strict canonical-type and parameter validation in the kernel.
